routing_description: Difficult starting, reported battery weakness and battery voltage during starting events.
planner_instructions: Review voltage history and, when operating-state observations exist, the starting summary. That summary pairs voltage with starting-state evidence at matching timestamps. Distinguish starting readings from other operating states and keep source IDs for both. A voltage pattern alone does not establish battery condition or a root cause. Missing starting-state evidence means a starting summary may be unavailable even when voltage history exists.
